Di balik proses latihan dan pertunjukan, persaingan antarpemeran, tekanan untuk memberikan penampilan terbaik, serta dinamika hubungan pribadi menjadi tantangan yang harus mereka hadapi. Sementara itu, Aqua diam-diam melanjutkan penyelidikannya terhadap sosok yang bertanggung jawab atas kematian Ai Hoshino, hingga menemukan petunjuk baru yang membawa penyelidikannya ke arah yang semakin berbahaya. Memadukan drama karakter yang emosional dengan gambaran realistis industri hiburan Jepang, musim ini menyajikan kisah tentang ambisi, pengorbanan, dan pencarian kebenaran.

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 10
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

programme.desc: Danny Reagan bergabung dengan Kepolisian Boston dari NYPD dan bermitra dengan Detektif Lena Peters, putri tertua dari keluarga penegak hukum terkemuka di Boston.

programme.title: Fast X
programme.desc: Dom Toretto dan keluarganya menjadi sasaran dendam putra gembong narkoba Hernan Reyes.

programme.title: FBI S8, Ep 17
programme.desc: FBI Season 8 mengikuti tim FBI New York menangani kasus berisiko tinggi, dari terorisme hingga kejahatan terorganisir. Di tengah ancaman meningkat, para agen menghadapi tekanan, konflik pribadi, dan keputusan sulit demi melindungi negara.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Kehidupan seorang pekerja pabrik, Douglas Quaid, berubah drastis saat ia menjadi buronan setelah mengunjungi Rekall, sebuah perusahaan yang menanamkan memori buatan pada klien-kliennya.

programme.title: Twisted Metal S2, Ep 6
programme.desc: Seorang warga luar harus mengantarkan paket misterius melintasi tanah tandus pasca-apokaliptik dengan imbalan kehidupan yang lebih baik.

programme.title: The Rookie: Feds S1, Ep 19
programme.desc: Saat melakukan inventarisasi kantor, Simone menemukan sejumlah mayat hingga menuntunnya untuk menyelidiki sebuah kasus yang melibatkan seorang taipan bisnis nan tertutup.

programme.title: The Rookie: Feds S1, Ep 20
programme.desc: Tim FBI bergegas melawan waktu untuk menghentikan seorang terpidana mati bernama Foster dan pengikut aliran sesatnya yang melakukan pembantaian sebelum hari eksekusinya tiba.

programme.title: The Rookie S6, Ep 3
programme.desc: John Nolan, seorang polisi senior di LAPD, telah menerapkan pengalaman hidup, tekad, dan selera humornya untuk bersaing dengan para petugas baru yang 20 tahun lebih muda dari dirinya.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex S7, Ep 5
programme.desc: Detektif Charlie Hudson dan rekan Gembala Jermannya yang luar biasa, Rex, semakin mempercayai tim mereka dan satu sama lain dalam menghadapi tantangan yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya. Bersama Rex, Inspektur Joe Donovan, Dr. Sarah Truong, dan spesialis teknologi Jesse Mills bekerja sama untuk memecahkan bahkan kejahatan paling luar biasa yang terjadi di St. John's.

programme.title: Uncharted Amazon S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Peru, seekor anteater sutra (silky anteater) berjuang untuk tetap terjaga, sementara seekor burung kolibri betina berusaha keras membesarkan anaknya. Selama jutaan tahun evolusi, mereka telah mengembangkan hubungan-hubungan yang unik dan strategi-strategi tak terduga untuk mengatasi perubahan kondisi lingkungan yang terus berlangsung. Namun, dengan segala kecerdikan yang mereka miliki, mereka tidak pernah siap menghadapi kedatangan spesies baru yang muncul di habitat mereka.

Selama jutaan tahun evolusi, mereka telah mengembangkan hubungan-hubungan yang unik dan strategi-strategi tak terduga untuk mengatasi perubahan kondisi lingkungan yang terus berlangsung. Tanpa disangka, sepatu ini ternyata memiliki kekuatan magis yang dapat mewujudkan impian dan memberikan keberuntungan. Ketika Lily mencoba sepatu tersebut, dia segera menemukan bahwa hidupnya mulai berubah drastis. Dia mendapatkan pekerjaan impiannya, bertemu dengan orang-orang penting, dan bahkan menarik perhatian seorang pangeran modern yang tampan.

Awalnya, dia merasa bingung dan takut, tetapi segera dia mulai mengeksplorasi kekuatan barunya dengan penuh semangat.

Bertekad mempertahankan warisan tersebut, ia bekerja sama dengan keluarga sambil menghadapi berbagai tantangan dan mempererat kembali hubungan yang sempat merenggang. Dengan latar pedesaan yang hangat, kisah persahabatan dengan kuda, serta semangat kebersamaan di musim Natal, Christmas Ranch menyuguhkan drama keluarga yang penuh inspirasi tentang harapan, ketekunan, dan arti sebuah rumah.

programme.title: Northern Borders
programme.desc: Northern Borders' mengisahkan tentang Austen Kittredge yang berusia sepuluh tahun, yang dikirim oleh ayahnya untuk tinggal di pertanian kakek-neneknya di Vermont. Di sana, ia mengalami petualangan liar dan mengungkap rahasia keluarga yang telah lama terpendam. Ceritanya berlatar tahun 1956, dan Austen merasakan pertanian itu sebagai tempat yang penuh dengan orang-orang eksentrik, terutama kakek-neneknya yang keras kepala, yang pernikahan mereka yang penuh masalah dikenal sebagai Perang Empat Puluh Tahun. Awalnya merasa terjebak di rumah tangga yang retak ini, Austen muda berencana untuk segera pergi, tetapi akhirnya terdampar tanpa pilihan selain beradaptasi dan bertahan. Sebuah kisah pendewasaan yang lucu dan terkadang mengejutkan, 'Northern Borders' membangkitkan nuansa liar Vermont, keindahannya yang luar biasa, masa lalu yang kelam, dan aura pesona.

Namun, salah satu dari mereka, yang curiga dan sangat sulit diprediksi, bersedia melakukan apa saja untuk mendapatkan uang itu.

Setiap tim harus menebak jawaban paling populer dari pertanyaan yang diajukan kepada 100 orang, sambil berusaha memenangkan hadiah untuk amal pilihan mereka.

programme.title: Matlock S1: Pregame
programme.desc: Gugatan class-action penting mengarahkan tim untuk menyelidiki sebuah perkumpulan mahasiswi. Selain itu, Matty membawa Alfie bersamanya ke Jacobson Moore pada Hari Keluarga.

programme.title: The Killer Nanny, Ep 2
programme.desc: Film dokumenter yang meninjau kembali persidangan Louise Woodward atas pembunuhan Matthew Eappen yang berusia delapan bulan, 25 tahun kemudian. Tiga bagian film ini berfokus pada kasus penuntutan, kasus pembelaan, dan dampak dari kasus tersebut.

programme.title: MasterChef S16: Global Feed
programme.desc: Koki selebriti dan bintang media sosial Nick DiGiovanni, mantan kontestan MasterChef, menjadi juri tamu saat para koki mengubah warisan budaya mereka menjadi tren makanan viral, bersaing untuk mendapatkan kesempatan berkolaborasi dengannya.

programme.title: Shark Tank S16, Ep 13
programme.desc: Para pengusaha mempresentasikan bisnis dan produk inovatif kepada para Sharks untuk mendapatkan investasi dan bimbingan. Musim ke-16 juga menjadi musim terakhir Mark Cuban sebagai Shark utama.

programme.title: Project Runway S21: Confidence
programme.desc: Para desainer menciptakan penampilan yang memukau untuk acara malam hari sambil bekerja dengan klien sungguhan.

programme.title: Ghosts S5: T-Daddy
programme.desc: Hubungan Trevor dengan putrinya menjadi tegang ketika ia mendorong putrinya untuk mengejar karier di bidang keuangan daripada puisi. Sementara itu, Jay menghadapi kerusuhan buruh di restoran.

programme.title: Arwah Goyang Jupe Depe (IMC)
programme.desc: Lilis terpaksa kembali menjadi penari di grup tari jaipong bernama Goyang Karawang. Namun, Neneng merasa terancam dengan kembalinya Lilis dan ia berusaha mempertahankan posisinya. Persaingan di antara mereka menjadi semakin seru.

programme.title: Pelet Kuntilanak
programme.desc: Pamela yang terobsesi dengan kecantikan menggunakan ilmu gaib berupa pelet dengan celana dalam pria sebagai medianya. Ia pun harus bersekutu dengan iblis agar dapat menguasai pelet tersebut.

programme.title: Darah Perawan Bulan Madu
programme.desc: Usai menikahi Amira, Putra mengajaknya berbulan madu di sebuah pulau miliknya. Namun, sejumlah peristiwa aneh mulai menghantui mereka saat sesosok hantu yang mengenakan gaun pengantin muncul.

programme.title: Ponirah Terpidana
programme.desc: Ponirah, yang dianggap sebagai pembawa kesialan bagi keluarganya, tergoda rayuan seorang mucikari untuk dijadikan wanita penghibur di Jakarta. Ponirah pun bertekad menjadi wanita penghibur termahal.

programme.title: Membakar Matahari
programme.desc: Setelah menikah dengan Rachman, Yanti mendapat pelajaran bela diri dari kakek suaminya. Hal ini ia lakukan demi membalas dendam kepada para perampok dan mucikari yang telah menjerumuskannya ke dalam dunia prostitusi.

programme.title: Membakar Matahari

programme.title: Kuntilanak 3
programme.desc: Sekelompok anak muda menjelajahi hutan angker untuk mencari teman-teman mereka yang hilang. Di tengah perjalanan, mereka bertemu seorang wanita misterius yang menuju desa mistis demi menemukan cara menghentikan kutukan kelam yang menjeratnya.

programme.title: Perempuan-Perempuan Liar
programme.desc: Dua penagih utang tak sengaja bertemu dua wanita gila bernama Mey dan Cindy. Mereka terjebak dalam permainan para gadis hingga membawa Mey kabur pada hari pernikahannya. Tragedi ini membuat ayah kedua gadis itu marah.

programme.title: Soekarno
programme.desc: Dari masa kecil yang rapuh hingga suara lantang di podium, seorang tokoh bernama Soekarno tumbuh dengan jiwa tak tergoyahkan. Cinta, pengorbanan, dan keyakinan besar menuntunnya menuju kebangkitan sebuah bangsa.

programme.title: Gentayangan (IMC)
programme.desc: Usai dinyatakan bangkrut oleh pengadilan, Abimanyu Karindra terpaksa mengajak istri, kedua anak, serta adiknya yang bernama Sheila untuk tinggal di hotel peninggalan orang tua di sebuah lembah gunung.

programme.title: Kuntilanak
programme.desc: Sam memilih untuk tinggal di sebuah rumah tua dekat pemakaman daripada tinggal bersama ayah tirinya. Namun, tak ada yang tahu bahwa ia berbakat untuk memanggil kuntilanak yang diyakini menghuni sebuah pohon besar.

programme.title: Nazar (IMC)
programme.desc: Cindy bernazar menikahi Jajat jika memenangkan mobil mewah. Setelah menang, ia mencoba mengingkari nazar dan mengalami berbagai kesialan. Akhirnya, Cindy mencari Jajat untuk memenuhi janji yang pernah diucapkannya.

programme.title: Ateng Minta Kawin
programme.desc: Ateng dan Vivi merahasiakan hubungan asmara mereka karena tidak mendapat restu dari kedua orang tua masing-masing.

programme.title: Hantu Budeg
programme.desc: Magda, Inge, Royce dan Bram meminta Kojek untuk mentraktir mereka liburan. Di tengah kegembiraan mereka, Magda mendapati bahwa terdapat beberapa penampakan di foto-foto yang ia ambil.

programme.title: Arwah Goyang Jupe Depe
programme.desc: Lilis terpaksa kembali menjadi seorang penari di sebuah grup tari jaipong bernama Goyang Karawang. Namun, kembalinya Lilis membuat Neneng merasa terancam dan berusaha mempertahankan posisinya.

programme.title: Dia Yang Tercinta
programme.desc: Harliman sangat terpukul saat kekasihnya, Lestari, menikah dengan Rachmat. Ia pun berusaha bangkit dengan bekerja di Kalimantan. Namun kemudian, ia nekat bekerja pada Rachmat demi merebut Lestari.

SELAIN MISI PENYELAMATAN, MEREKA JUGA HARUS MENGHADAPI KONFLIK SEHARI-HARI DI SEKOLAH, TERUTAMA DARI GENG MUSUH MEREKA, THE BEAST. ANIMASI INI BERFOKUS PADA KISAH PERSAHABATAN, KEKOMPAKAN, DAN PENGGUNAAN KEKUATAN SUPER UNTUK KEBAIKAN.

DENGAN MENAMPILKAN FILM-FILM ANIMASI YANG MENGHIBUR DAN CERITA-CERITA MENARIK, ACARA INI MEMPERSEMBAHKAN PETUALANGAN-PETUALANGAN YANG LUCU DAN PENUH PESAN MORAL YANG BISA DINIKMATI BERSAMA. programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 23: THE JOURNEYS
programme.desc: POKEMON JOURNEYS ADALAH SERI ANIME POKEMON YANG MENGIKUTI PETUALANGAN SEORANG PELATIH POKEMON BERNAMA ASH KETCHUM DAN TEMANNYA, GOH. MEREKA MELAKUKAN PERJALANAN MELINTASI BERBAGAI WILAYAH POKEMON UNTUK MENGEJAR IMPIAN MEREKA. programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. Di sana, si kembar Jade dan Mica mendapati dunia mereka terbalik ketika orang tua mereka yang seorang penjelajah mempercayakan tiga telur Marsupilami misterius kepada mereka. Setelah menetas, kedua saudara ini harus kreatif untuk menyembunyikan teman-teman baru mereka—lagipula, tidak ada yang tahu keberadaan makhluk-makhluk energik ini, dan predator bisa saja mengintai di setiap sudut.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Seorang polisi tangguh harus menyamar sebagai guru taman kanak-kanak untuk menemukan mantan istri seorang penjahat berbahaya, yang mungkin memegang kunci untuk menjebloskannya ke balik jeruji besi.

programme.title: A Time To Kill
programme.desc: Di Canton, Mississippi, seorang pengacara muda yang tak kenal takut dan asistennya membela seorang pria kulit hitam yang dituduh membunuh dua pria kulit putih yang memperkosa putrinya yang berusia sepuluh tahun, memicu pembalasan dan balas dendam yang kejam dari Ku Klux Klan.

programme.title: The Big Boss (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda Tionghoa yang telah bersumpah untuk tidak melakukan kekerasan pindah ke Thailand untuk bekerja bersama sepupu-sepupunya di sebuah pabrik es, yang kemudian ia temukan sebagai kedok operasi penyelundupan heroin yang keji.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Es di kutub telah mencair, dan bumi ditutupi oleh air. Manusia-manusia yang tersisa pergi mengarungi lautan untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Di tengah musim dingin Wyoming yang mencekam, seorang pemburu hadiah dan tahanannya menemukan tempat berlindung di sebuah pondok yang saat itu dihuni oleh sekelompok karakter jahat.

programme.title: Back To The Future 3
programme.desc: Terdampar di tahun 1955, Marty McFly mengetahui kematian Doc Brown di tahun 1885 dan harus kembali ke masa lalu untuk menyelamatkannya. Tanpa bahan bakar yang tersedia untuk DeLorean, keduanya harus mencari cara untuk melarikan diri dari Old West sebelum Emmett dibunuh.

programme.title: Widows
programme.desc: Empat wanita yang tidak memiliki kesamaan apa pun kecuali hutang yang ditinggalkan oleh aktivitas kriminal suami mereka yang telah meninggal, mengambil nasib ke tangan mereka sendiri dan bersekongkol untuk membangun masa depan sesuai keinginan mereka.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Es di kutub telah mencair, dan bumi ditutupi oleh air. Manusia-manusia yang tersisa pergi mengarungi lautan untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: The Bodyguard From Beijing
programme.desc: Seorang taipan korup membunuh saksi kejahatan. Hanya pacar seorang pengusaha yang memiliki hubungan dengan pemerintah Tiongkok yang melihat kejadian tersebut. Pengawal dari Beijing membantu polisi Hong Kong melindunginya. Namun, ia dan saksi tersebut mulai memiliki perasaan, yang memperumit keadaan.

programme.title: L.A. Confidential
programme.desc: Seiring dengan meningkatnya korupsi di Los Angeles pada tahun 1950-an, tiga polisi satu yang kaku, satu yang kejam, dan satu yang licik menyelidiki serangkaian pembunuhan dengan cara mereka sendiri dalam menegakkan keadilan.

programme.title: Twin Dragons (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Sepasang kembar identik dipisahkan saat lahir, yang satu menjadi mekanik jalanan berpengalaman, dan yang lain menjadi konduktor konser klasik terkenal. Mereka bertemu di usia dewasa, dan dikira sebagai orang yang sama dan terjerat dalam dunia satu sama lain.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Rambo, seorang veteran Pasukan Khusus Green Beret, berhadapan dengan seorang sheriff di wilayah Pasifik Barat Laut dan Garda Nasional.

programme.title: The Revenant (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Seorang penjelajah perbatasan dalam ekspedisi perdagangan bulu pada tahun 1820-an berjuang untuk bertahan hidup setelah diterkam beruang dan ditinggalkan dalam keadaan sekarat oleh anggota tim berburunya sendiri.

programme.title: Curse Of King Tut's Tomb, Pt 1

programme.title: Curse Of King Tut's Tomb, Pt 2

programme.title: Asmara Gen Z New Era
programme.desc: Sinetron yang bercerita tentang persahabatan, cinta dan serunya keseharian para Gen Z. Dibintangi oleh AQEELA CALISTA, FATTAH SYACH, ARYA MOHAN, NICOLE ROSSI, HARRY VAUGHAN dan RAISA MARIE. Tayang setiap hari pukul 17.00 WIB.

programme.title: Asmara Gen Z New Era
programme.desc: Kisah para Gen Z berlanjut saat Mohan, Aqeela, Harry, dan teman-temannya memasuki babak baru kehidupan di bangku kuliah. Di tengah dunia kampus yang penuh warna, mereka dipertemukan dengan Salvatore, Gizelle, Gavin, Cantika, Savanna, dan Renzo, yang membawa warna baru dalam persahabatan, cinta, dan ambisi mereka.

programme.title: Seindah Masa Remaja
programme.desc: Kanaya (Sandrinna Michelle) seorang gadis remaja yang populer di sekolah, namun di rumah ia hanyalah seorang kakak yang harus menjaga adiknya, Alisa (Giselle Irene), apalagi Alisa yang memutuskan untuk sekolah bersama Kanaya. Tidak hanya itu, di sekolah Kanaya harus berhadapan dengan cinta pertamanya Arga (Andy William) dan Dastan (Lazuardy Nasution), anak baru yang tengil di sekolah. Bagaimanakah nasib Kanaya selanjutnya? Sakiskan SINETRON TERBARU SEINDAH MASA REMAJA

programme.title: Seindah Masa Remaja
programme.desc: Kanaya menjalani masa SMA yang penuh warna sebagai kapten tim dance populer, hingga kedatangan adiknya, Alisa, mengubah segalanya. Di tengah persahabatan, cinta pertama, persaingan, dan rahasia yang harus disembunyikan, keduanya menghadapi perjalanan remaja yang menguji arti keluarga, mimpi, dan cinta.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Mommy Says
programme.desc: Mommy Says adalah program talk show gaya hidup dari Sanlih E-Television yang dipandu oleh Lin Shu-wei. Setiap episode membahas berbagai topik yang dekat dengan kehidupan sehari-hari, mulai dari perawatan kecantikan, tren busana, kesehatan, parenting, hingga tips menjadi konsumen yang cerdas. Bersama para ahli dan bintang tamu, acara ini menghadirkan informasi praktis, inspiratif, dan mudah diterapkan untuk membantu pemirsa menjalani kehidupan yang lebih sehat, percaya diri, dan berkualitas.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online adalah program talk show gaya hidup dari Sanlih E-Television yang membahas berbagai isu menarik seputar kehidupan modern. Dalam setiap episode, para host bersama bintang tamu dan pakar mengulas tren kecantikan, fashion, kesehatan, hubungan, keluarga, hingga pengembangan diri melalui diskusi yang ringan namun informatif. Dikemas secara interaktif dan menghibur, acara ini memberikan inspirasi sekaligus tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Girls Tease adalah program talk show yang mengangkat berbagai topik seputar kehidupan perempuan masa kini. Dipandu oleh Tien Hsin dan Fabien Yang, setiap episode menghadirkan selebritas, pakar, serta perwakilan masyarakat untuk berbagi pengalaman dan berdiskusi mengenai tren kecantikan, fashion, percintaan, karier, kesehatan, hingga berbagai tantangan yang dihadapi perempuan urban. Dikemas dengan suasana santai, interaktif, dan penuh humor, acara ini menyuguhkan informasi sekaligus hiburan yang relevan bagi penonton modern.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: Top Singers menghadirkan para penyanyi berbakat yang menunjukkan kemampuan vokal dan gaya musik mereka melalui berbagai penampilan menarik. Setiap episode menampilkan interpretasi lagu-lagu populer, kisah perjalanan musik para penyanyi, serta momen spesial yang memperlihatkan bakat dan karakter unik masing-masing artis. Program ini menjadi wadah apresiasi bagi para musisi dan pecinta musik.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz menghadirkan berbagai informasi terkini seputar industri hiburan, mulai dari kabar selebritas, film, serial televisi, musik, hingga gaya hidup. Program ini juga menyuguhkan liputan di balik layar, wawancara eksklusif dengan para artis, serta ulasan mengenai tren dan peristiwa terbaru di dunia entertainment. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan informatif, Show Biz menjadi sumber informasi bagi penonton yang ingin mengikuti perkembangan industri hiburan.

programme.title: Love Now
programme.desc: Love Now mengisahkan Yang Yi Ru, seorang eksekutif periklanan yang terlalu fokus pada pekerjaannya hingga membuat keluarga dan sahabatnya khawatir. Demi memaksanya beristirahat, mereka membuatnya percaya bahwa usianya tidak akan lama lagi. Dalam perjalanan yang dijalaninya, Yi Ru bertemu Lan Shi De dan perlahan menjalin hubungan yang penuh kehangatan. Di tengah berbagai kesalahpahaman, konflik keluarga, dan tantangan hidup, keduanya belajar tentang arti cinta, kepercayaan, dan pentingnya menghargai setiap momen dalam kehidupan.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour mengajak para selebritas untuk berkompetisi menyusun rencana perjalanan dengan tema dan anggaran tertentu. Dalam setiap episode, mereka mengunjungi berbagai destinasi wisata, mencicipi kuliner khas, serta memperkenalkan tempat-tempat menarik yang layak dikunjungi. Melalui pengalaman seru, interaksi yang menghibur, dan rekomendasi perjalanan yang praktis, program ini memberikan inspirasi wisata bagi para penonton.

programme.desc: Jad et ses soeurs mengisahkan kehidupan sehari-hari Jad bersama dua saudara kembarnya, Ranya dan Syrine. Dalam setiap episode, mereka menghadapi berbagai situasi yang dekat dengan dunia anak-anak, mulai dari kegiatan sekolah, permainan bersama teman, perjalanan keluarga, hingga tantangan kecil yang mengajarkan nilai-nilai kehidupan. Dengan latar budaya Maroko yang kental, serial animasi ini memperkenalkan tradisi, kebiasaan, dan keramahan masyarakat setempat. Dikemas dengan humor dan cerita yang hangat, serial ini mengajarkan pentingnya kerja sama, rasa hormat, tanggung jawab, serta kasih sayang dalam keluarga.

programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI
programme.desc: Compostman et Moi adalah dokumenter yang mengisahkan perjalanan Florian Bonnet, seorang aktivis lingkungan yang dikenal dengan julukan "Compostman". Dengan semangat mengurangi limbah makanan dan meningkatkan kesadaran akan pentingnya pengelolaan sampah organik, ia berkeliling menemui berbagai komunitas untuk memperkenalkan manfaat pengomposan. Melalui kisah-kisah inspiratif, inisiatif masyarakat, dan penjelasan mengenai dampak positif pengomposan terhadap lingkungan, dokumenter ini menunjukkan bagaimana tindakan sederhana sehari-hari dapat membantu mengurangi sampah, memperbaiki kualitas tanah, dan mendukung gaya hidup yang lebih ramah lingkungan.

programme.desc: Birds on a Wire – Le Chant des Oiseaux menghadirkan rekaman konser istimewa dari duo Rosemary Standley dan Dom La Nena yang merayakan sepuluh tahun perjalanan musik mereka sebagai Birds on a Wire. Direkam di Philharmonie de Paris, pertunjukan ini menghadirkan kolaborasi bersama Maîtrise de Radio France di bawah arahan Morgan Jourdain. Melalui aransemen vokal dan cello yang khas, mereka membawakan karya-karya klasik, lagu rakyat dari berbagai budaya, hingga komposisi modern dengan sentuhan yang intim dan emosional. programme.title: The Five-Year Engagement
programme.desc: New York executive Paul Racine is on a business trip in Japan when he meets the stunning, enigmatic Kirina. They spend the night together in her hotel room, and Racine returns the next day to retrieve his forgotten keys. But once he's there, he witnesses Kirina's assassination by Kinjo, the leader of a ninja cult. Realizing that Racine has seen everything, Kinjo will do everything in his power to end the executive's life.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga Tatsumi is a crazy-strong, ruthless high school delinquent who's nicknamed the "Rampaging Ogre". One day, while dunking some punk, he rescues a big guy who comes ~floating~ down the river. When he does, the big guy splits in half and out pops a bouncing baby boy! But this baby is actually Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV (Baby Beel), the son of the Great Demon Lord, and he came from the Demon World in order to destroy humanity!

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Gerry [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: An ex-con and his devoted wife must flee from danger when a heist doesn't go as planned.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: The Heart Of Me [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Set in 1930s London with two sisters, Madeleine married to Rickie, and Dinah, who falls in love with him.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: All I See Is You [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Gina is a beautiful young woman who's still haunted by the accident that took her sight years earlier. Living in Bangkok with her husband, James, she undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores the vision to her right eye. Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: Angela de Marco (Michelle Pfeiffer) is fed up with her gangster husband's (Alec Baldwin) line of work and wants no part of the crime world. When her husband is killed for having an affair with the mistress of mob boss Tony "The Tiger" Russo (Dean Stockwell), Angela and her son depart for New York City to make a fresh start. Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent (Matthew Modine) looking to use her to bust Tony.

programme.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
programme.desc: Chainsaw-wielding maniac Leatherface (Bill Johnson) is up to his cannibalistic ways once again, along with the rest of his twisted clan, including the equally disturbed Chop-Top (Bill Moseley). This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: As a young boy, Tim (Aaron Murphy) witnesses the horrifying event of his father (Charles Mesure) being dragged away by the boogeyman. Despite the reassurances of his mother (Lucy Lawless) that the boogeyman is not real, he is never the same afterward. Years later, Tim (Barry Watson) manages to create a normal life for himself -- though he lives without closets and keeps his mattress on the floor. But when he learns of his mother's death, Tim must return home to face his childhood trauma.

programme.title: Boogeyman 2
programme.desc: A killer terrorizes patients at a mental institution where a woman (Danielle Savre) tries to cure her fear of the boogeyman.

programme.title: Boogeyman 3
programme.desc: An evil entity terrorizes a student (Erin Cahill) and her friends on a college campus.

programme.title: Evil Toons
programme.desc: Four sorority sisters get more than they bargained for when they agree to renovate a haunted mansion.

programme.title: Campfire Tales
programme.desc: On a desolate highway, several stranded teenagers pass the time by telling scary stories around a makeshift fire.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.title: Baby on Board
programme.desc: A power couple (Jerry O'Connell, Heather Graham) has a surprise pregnancy that throws their lives and careers into a tailspin.

programme.title: Not Another Happy Ending
programme.desc: After discovering that his only successful author (Karen Gillan) has writer's block because she's too happy, a publisher (Stanley Weber) tries to inspire her creativity by making her miserable.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

programme.title: Wisegirls
programme.desc: Low on money and fresh out of hope, aspiring doctor Meg Kennedy is forced to return home to Staten Island, N.Y., where she finds work as a waitress at Santalino's, a boisterous Italian restaurant. Soon, Meg befriends coworkers Raychel and Kate and begins a new life. But after Meg discovers that Santalino's is a mob front, she finds herself deep in danger, and is recruited by the police to spy on her criminally connected boss.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: Breaking and Entering
programme.desc: Will (Jude Law), a landscape architect in London, is in the middle of a life crisis. His relationship with Liv (Robin Wright Penn), a depressive Scandinavian, is going nowhere. A burglary at his office leads him to Amira (Juliette Binoche), a Bosnian refugee whose husband died in Sarajevo. Will is drawn to the vulnerable woman and initiates an affair.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters.

programme.title: De-Lovely

As he trades notes with the play's director, Gabe (Jonathan Pryce), Porter recollects his meteoric rise on Broadway during the mid-1920s and his first meeting with wife and muse Linda Thomas (Ashley Judd). He also recalls his many extramarital, homosexual dalliances, and the deep depression and seclusion of his final years.

programme.title: Six Degrees of Separation
programme.desc: Privileged art dealers Flan (Donald Sutherland) and Ouisa (Stockard Channing) are hosting a dinner party when Paul (Will Smith), a blood-soaked young man, arrives on their doorstep. He claims to be a friend of their Ivy League children, and charms his way into the house. But when the couple discovers the truth about Paul and his real identity, they kick him out. As the couple trades stories with their friends about Paul, his presence proves surprisingly hard to shake.

programme.title: Backtrack
programme.desc: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be.

The robbery goes off flawlessly, but Skip attempts to double-cross the gang afterward, killing two of them. When the pair encounter an underground community, the leader's daughter, Quilla Holmes, seduces Vic into their fold, separating him from Blood, who's left to survive on his own. But once Vic discovers he's been lured there solely for mechanized procreation, he realizes he's doomed unless he can escape and rejoin Blood.

With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: All is well at Area Fifty-Something with Team Monster, until a lone alien imprisons the President and makes a permanent home on base.

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: The president's birthday is here! Dr. C has made him a gadget that will make him appear younger, but instead blasts him to infanthood!
programme.sub-title: Danger Wears a Diaper/The Toy From Another World

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: Susan makes B.O.B. think that baths cure crankiness - B.O.B. leaps into action, chasing after Coverton to cure his crankiness once and for all!
programme.sub-title: The Bath Effect/The Fruit of All Evil

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: B.O.B. is determined to have Coverton be his emergency buddy. Instead, Coverton chooses to manipulate B.O.B. at a time when he needs him the most.

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: The Monsters find an alien in the woods doing an earth studies project, which has a lot of sensitive data that could be used for an invasion!
programme.sub-title: It Came...On a Field Trip/Educational Television

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: B.O.B. discovers a secret switch that General Monger tells him not to touch. Will it get rewired before the Big Blue Blob can get to flip it?

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: Dr. C is split into two through his new teleportation machine. Can the Monsters reunite the wild and brainy roaches before it's too late?
programme.sub-title: The Two Faces of Dr. Cockroach/The Thing With One Brain

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: Sqweep fashions a canine brainwave device to make B.O.B. the perfect pet. It works great on everyone on the base but B.O.B.
programme.sub-title: Night of the Living Dog/Attack of the Movie Night

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: Dr. C doubles his strength, but lessens his genius. Can the other Monsters save him before it's too late?

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: When Dr. C invents a "living" smart-phone, Coverton diabolically plans to use the smart-phone to hack the base's mainframe.
programme.sub-title: Screaming Your Calls/The Time-Out That Wouldn't End

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: It's April Fool's Day at Area Fifty-Something as Susan tries to prevent the Monsters from destroying the base with a prank! Dr. C's "Ph.D" is in jeopardy as a former teacher reveals a missing music grade in his transcript.
programme.sub-title: It Got Out of Hand/The Sound of Fear

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: A new alien, Sta'abi, comes to Earth in search of a ferocious beast called Vornicarn. Soon, everyone is on a chase in order to save the planet from Vornicarn's terror!

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: Susan is in a bind after spilling food on Sta'abi and apologizing about it. Insulted, Sta'abi hunts Susan to feed her "fralnick" to Vornicarn.
programme.sub-title: The Sorry Syndrome/Speak Not the Q Word

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: Strange secrets begin to unfold when Derek returns to expose our friends at Area Fifty Something. Monger is away for the weekend! This is great news for Team Monster and Team Alien until they're introduced to Rule-Bot.
programme.sub-title: It Came From Channel 5/It Ruled with an Iron Fist

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: Link and Sta'abi duel for driving privileges of a new supercar. Sqweep wants to drive too though, and takes off on a supersonic joyride.
programme.sub-title: Driven to Madness/The Beast From 20,000 Gallons

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: With everyone down with alien flu, Coverton tries to steal base secrets, but fails to account for a huge gelatinous hallucinating B.O.B. Vornicarn's bad behavior lands him in the Isolation Zone.
programme.sub-title: The Sneezing Horror/Prisoner of the Dark Dimension

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens CA
programme.desc: B.O.B. eats Dr. C's "probabilitator" and foresees Coverton with a crown, but soon Coverton discovers the painful truth about his future.

programme.title: Pokemon the Series

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Right on the heels of the Pokémon Contest, Ash, Dawn, and Brock all decide to enter Hearthome City’s Tag Battle Competition, where teams of two Trainers face off!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Ash has been paired up with his rival Paul for the Tag Battle Competition—but Paul is pushing his Chimchar way too hard!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: The Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition is coming to an exciting conclusion, as all of our heroes are set to face each other in the last few rounds!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: On the way to Veilstone City and Ash’s next Gym battle, a trio of angry Zangoose force Chimchar to face its fearful past.

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: James must decide whether to keep his beloved Cacnea or allow it to train and grow strong with Gardenia, the Eterna Gym Leader.

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: As our heroes draw closer to Ash’s next Gym battle and Dawn’s next Pokémon Contest, they consider the pros and cons of a Pokémon trade!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Continuing on their way to Solaceon Town and then Veilstone City, our heroes accidentally free a mean-spirited Spiritomb from the keystone that has held it captive for 500 years.

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: On their way to Solaceon Town, our heroes run into a worried stonecutter who’s working on a stone bridge that must be completed within three days. Can they help her?

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Ash and friends come across a feisty young Trainer named Alan, whose newly evolved Probopass is Team Rocket’s latest target!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: On their way to Solaceon Town, our heroes meet a young detective who is struggling to cope with her angry Luxray.

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Arriving in Solaceon Town, site of Dawn’s upcoming Pokémon Contest, our heroes come across Team Galactic in the process of stealing a valuable treasure guarded by a group of Unown.

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: The Solaceon Pokémon Contest is finally under way! Can Dawn and her newly evolved Ambipom take on her old friend Kenny and Jessilina?

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: On the way to Veilstone City for Ash’s next Gym battle, our heroes stop at a Maid Café, where one of the owners is having some trouble with her Miltank.

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Dawn introduces our heroes to her old friend Leona, whose family runs a hotel built around a hot spring. Unfortunately, business seems to be drying up…

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Our heroes find themselves in a sprawling city that has been overrun by a group of lost Gligar and their leader Gliscor.

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: On their way to Veilstone City, our heroes must cross a desert, where they meet a massive Hippowdon—a friend of the Hippopotas they once rescued!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: When they arrive in Veilstone City, our heroes face several important challenges—but Ash’s long-awaited Gym battle isn’t one of them!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: In an attempt to help Gym Leader Maylene through her crisis of confidence, Dawn issues a challenge. It’s Dawn’s very first Gym battle!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Our heroes are all set to head out toward their next destination when the mysterious Team Galactic appears, with an evil plot to establish a new world!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Team Rocket is hot on the trail of our heroes when Jessie’s Dustox has an encounter that leaves her with a tough decision!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Ash and Pikachu meet an unusual Trainer who would really like to add a Pikachu to his team of Pichu and Raichu!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series

programme.title: Pokemon the Series

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: The second round of the Wallace Cup has arrived, and Dawn, Ash, May, and Zoey are all in the victory hunt!

programme.title: Pokemon the Series
programme.desc: Dawn faces the prospect of battling against her rival Zoey or her new friend May in the final round of the prestigious Wallace Cup!

programme.desc: When our heroes encounter Ash’s rival Paul outside Pastoria City, Chimchar—who joined Ash’s team after Paul left it behind—is itching for a battle!

When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? programme.desc: Loki arrives at Avengers Tower declaring he wants to be an Avenger. Our heroes are skeptical, but Iron Man decides to make Loki an ”Avenger In Training”. It's a great plan until Thanos arrives on Earth looking for Loki

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: Gorilla's Gone Wild
programme.desc: Cragger angers the Gorilla tribe and they march to the Crocodile Swamp to teach him a lesson. But the Gorilla Mechs are not fit for the swampy water and the Lions and Eagles must come to the rescue. The only problem is that the Lions don't like water ... at all!

programme.title: The Haunted and the Hunted!

programme.title: The Snowball Effect
programme.desc: Laval and Li'Ella's relationship grows as he gives her a tour of the Lion City. But distracted, he misses a key battle against the Hunters. Tormak joins the fight and saves the day. But the Lion King Lagravis is captured and brought to the Ice Fort. Who will lead the Lions now?!?

programme.title: Friends Reunite
programme.desc: Olly about how his obsession is affecting their relationships. Olly refuses to see the damage he's causing, but it becomes clear that he's lost touch with what really matters.

programme.title: All Of Nothing
programme.desc: The ninja and Sensei Wu try to infiltrate the Serpentines' inner sanctum and walk right into a trap, and when Lloyd's rescue mission fails, there is only one person who can help them, namely the evil Lord Garmadon – but can they trust him?

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Maximum Overload
programme.desc: Spider-Man and Marvel's Super Heroes take on a mischievous Loki and a team of super villains in an all-new LEGO adventure

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Snow Way
programme.desc: Practicing for the local snow lodge's big snowboard race, Mia has an accident and hurts her ankle. She insists it's no biggie, but when she tries to resume practice, the normally fearless Mia finds she's now terrified of snowboarding! At the local snow lodge's Snowboard Meet, ace snowboarder Mia, trying to raise money for a new Heartlake City animal shelter, enters the fiercest race of all – the Boardercross. Then, while practicing, she has an accident and hurts her ankle. She insists it's no big deal, but once she heals and tries to resume practice, the usually fearless Mia finds she's now terrified of snowboarding! With the help of her Friends, she tries hard to overcome her fear, but her nightmarish visions of snowboard monsters and jeering snowmen have her shaking in her bed. She backs out of the race, disappointing her Friends and herself. Finally, when an avalanche traps Fiona, Mia is forced to overcome her fears and race to the rescue.
